full_judgment: 12. It is now a well settled provision of law is that exercising the, power conferred under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure this Court can- not go in to the factual aspect even in a case of reversal of judgment and decree otherwise the petitioner can show any misreading or misinterpretation of law and fact which effecting the ultimate result of the Courts below. In the present case in hand the petitioner raised the question of misreading of evidence as well as misinterpretation of law.
